$comment: RGCompanion's parity with the page (G42.0). Every settings section, Canvas viewer kind, chat item and wire message of the page has a row: app = native | embed | partial | no | n/a, the app's files that do it (paths under apps/companion), the G42 phase that closes it, the study rows (memory/study_g42_parita.md). Checked by packages/web/test/companion-parity.test.ts and apps/companion/test/parity_test.dart.

general.note: Native (G42.4): theme, interface language, agents' language, instructions for all with the PromptRefiner (diff, writer model, tools proposal), backup model, web search, voice messages, images, updates, What's new whenever, debug log, sign out; Safety (guardian, approvals, spending, skills, retention) in Settings › Safety.

system.note: Native: the machine's name and state; role, storage, disks, SSH, Wi-Fi, HTTPS only in «All settings».

setup.note: The app's first start does about 4 of the wizard's 17 steps; «redo the setup» only in «All settings».

agents.note: Native (G42.4): the tree at every level (open and close, projects, assigned, stopped, «Agent under»), the new agent with every step of the page's wizards and God's instructions and tools, assistants' services, routines and skills, the whole agent's settings (read only for an archived project); pause, resume, remove, «Removed agents» (3.8.9). A new routine opens the whole automation editor with the assistant chosen (G42.9); adding a service goes to Extensions (G42.11).

memory.note: Native (G42.10): Settings › Shared memory (the two kinds side by side, learns by itself, add, edit, delete with undo, forget for good, where each came from, space used, the last changes undoable); an agent's own and its project's memory, the way to the shared one and the automatic summaries in its Memory tab.

knowledge.note: Native (G42.10): state of the index with its bar, why the search goes by words only, collections and who they are for, sources (folder, file, web page, project, mailbox, conversations; Rasgeth's folders, files sent from the device, or a path), what was left out, try a search, embedding and rerank models with their download bar, cloud API, threads, OCR, disk, backup of the vectors, Rebuild, Pause; an agent's Knowledge tab with the page's choices; `#kb:` citations open in the app. Files dropped on a card (drag and drop) are not there yet.

automations.note: Native (G42.9): the list with its switch, runs, run now, the webhook's secret shown once, delete; a new automation or reminder; the whole editor (When, Only if, What it does, Where it tells you, Advanced, the YAML in a coloured field, the next times from the server), ported from AutomationEditor.tsx and checked with the page's vectors; the magic automation with God (proposal beside the conversation, needs, approve, change, reject); an assistant's routines with the same editor; the messages in For you, the bell and the system's notifications (push kind automation). The mailboxes are only listed (added in Channels and mailboxes, G42.13).

extensions.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native extensions, MCP and skills in G42.11. 3.9.7: Settings › Skills native (skills_screen.dart): the agents' skills waiting (a new version with its reason and what changes word by word, approve or reject), the installed skills with their versions (who, why, when, the one in use), compared and brought back after a yes.

keychain.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native keychain in G42.12.

telegram.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native Telegram setup in G42.13.

chats.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native chat platforms and mailboxes in G42.13.

budgets.note: Native (G42.4): this month's total with its days, everything, each project and agent with their limit; the limit's window with the wizard's amounts, another amount or no limit.

subscriptions.note: Default model and model routes are native; subscriptions, keys, own server and local models only in «All settings».

code.note: G42.5: Settings › Code as the page's CodeSettings and GitCode.tsx: GitHub and Gitea as two tiles lit when linked, each with its window (GitHub's guide for a fine-grained token, «Try and save», «Disconnect»; Gitea started here with its job followed step by step and the image's download bar, or one the person has, with the page's words when its name or address does not answer; «Open Gitea», «Switch off»), and «Create the repositories now» with each project's outcome. Same routes; nothing kept in the app.

remote.note: The access link from outside is shown read only; password, 2FA, sessions, Tailscale, Cloudflare only in «All settings».

backup.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native backup and targets in G42.14.

platform.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native Platform history in G42.17.

tools.note: Native (G42.4): the common tools with their cost, search, the essential ones locked, exceptions per agent back to «As for everyone», the extensions' tools; one agent's tools in its settings and when it is made. 3.9.4: the tool groups (off by default, always on, off by you) with their cost, for every agent and in an agent's settings (ToolKitsSection, AgentKits).

import.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native import from other agents in G42.17.

commands.note: Native (G42.4): one page as the page's Settings › Commands: agents at work together with the live queue, background commands, normal commands, steps.

requests.note: Native (G42.4): ask me or don't ask me anything (the classifier and its model), the time to answer and what happens after it, the truly dangerous requests, the classifier's decisions; answering requests in Inbox.

projects.note: Project list with git state (advanced interface); 3.8.8: a click shows the project's conversations (its lead's and its team's; archived, read only with its tasks), its menu archives it (the page's window: who works, the automations that pause), restores it and initialises git; the full Settings › Projects page only in «All settings». 2026-11-18: «Agenti al massimo in questo progetto» (0-10, default 3) native: in the project's menu (its window) and in the project's view, the same slider, rule and words as the page's Settings › Projects.

artifacts.note: Settings of the server › Artifacts: by place, facts, permissions (grant with a cap, take back), open, export (.rgartifact with or without its data, or HTML), delete, import into a place; capability sentences from the protocol's vectors.

acp.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native external ACP agents in G42.17.

machines.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native SSH machines in G42.14.

nodes.note: Only inside «All settings» (the page in a web view; the browser on Windows and Linux); native node pairing in G42.14.

devices.note: Native: list, rename (G42.4), revoke and push test.

voice.note: Who reads aloud, volume and press-and-talk are native; hands-free, wake word and transcription service settings are not.

portrait.note: Native (3.9.4): Settings › Portrait («Mirror»): on/off, who reads it, the traits grouped with how sure and where each comes from (the conversation opens), change with category, remove, not true, add by hand, the text the agents read, forget everything.

video.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside); codecs as the web view has them (WebKitGTK: GStreamer with gst-libav).

audio.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside).

image.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside); the native viewer (png/jpg/gif/webp/bmp, SVG with flutter_svg) stays as the fallback; editing in the page's editor inside the same embed (G42.7): collaboration, the agent's marks, «Changes», proposals and «changed outside» come with the page, the save state in the native bar (a failure with why and «Try saving again»), Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed on when the focus is in the frame, «Ask the agent» about a selection into the conversation's composer (a phone goes back to the conversation), an archived project's file opened in its viewer and said read only; ImageEditor and SvgEditor: pen and touch reach the page's own pointer handling (the web view takes every gesture), «Paste a picture» and Ctrl/Cmd+V from the system's clipboard as a new layer, «Export as» through «Save as…», «Open in Krita» only where the server's computer is at hand (not from a phone).

pdf.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside), search included; pdfx stays as the fallback; editing in the page's editor inside the same embed (G42.7): collaboration, the agent's marks, «Changes», proposals and «changed outside» come with the page, the save state in the native bar (a failure with why and «Try saving again»), Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed on when the focus is in the frame, «Ask the agent» about a selection into the conversation's composer (a phone goes back to the conversation), an archived project's file opened in its viewer and said read only; PdfEditor: the pictures for stamps and signatures from the app's picker, a kept version saved through «Save as…».

markdown.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside); the native Markdown stays as the fallback; editing in the page's editor inside the same embed (G42.7): collaboration, the agent's marks, «Changes», proposals and «changed outside» come with the page, the save state in the native bar (a failure with why and «Try saving again»), Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed on when the focus is in the frame, «Ask the agent» about a selection into the conversation's composer (a phone goes back to the conversation), an archived project's file opened in its viewer and said read only; TextEditor (CodeMirror): the selection with its lines, and the line being typed kept above a phone's keyboard.

code.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside), highlighted; plain source as the fallback; editing in the page's editor inside the same embed (G42.7): collaboration, the agent's marks, «Changes», proposals and «changed outside» come with the page, the save state in the native bar (a failure with why and «Try saving again»), Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed on when the focus is in the frame, «Ask the agent» about a selection into the conversation's composer (a phone goes back to the conversation), an archived project's file opened in its viewer and said read only; TextEditor (CodeMirror): the selection with its lines, and the line being typed kept above a phone's keyboard.

text.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside); plain source as the fallback; editing in the page's editor inside the same embed (G42.7): collaboration, the agent's marks, «Changes», proposals and «changed outside» come with the page, the save state in the native bar (a failure with why and «Try saving again»), Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed on when the focus is in the frame, «Ask the agent» about a selection into the conversation's composer (a phone goes back to the conversation), an archived project's file opened in its viewer and said read only; TextEditor (CodeMirror): the selection with its lines, and the line being typed kept above a phone's keyboard.

table.note: The page's viewer and SheetEditor (Univer) through embed=canvas inside the native frame: formulas computed in the page as there, the copy as ODS of a closed sheet (SheetCopy), Export as… through the app's «Save as…», save state in the native bar, Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, F from the app.

sheet.note: The page's viewer and SheetEditor (Univer) through embed=canvas inside the native frame: formulas computed in the page as there, the copy as ODS of a closed sheet (SheetCopy), Export as… through the app's «Save as…», save state in the native bar, Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, F from the app.

document.note: The page's viewer and editor through embed=canvas inside the native frame. Documents and slides open the embed isolated as a whole (/embed-isolated.html, COOP/COEP): LibreOffice's frame has SharedArrayBuffer in WKWebView and WebKitGTK too (G42.8: Playwright WebKit and the Linux app), Chromium web views also through Document-Isolation-Policy. The engine comes down the first time with the page's bar (amounts, speed, time left, «Annulla», «Riprova») into the web view's storage (rg-zeta-*); Export as, PDF to print, the original's kept versions and Find/Replace through the page, their «Save as…» over the bridge. On a phone the pages as printed with Find and Replace (as the page). Where the engine still cannot start the page says why in the app's words and «Open in the browser» opens Rasgeth's page with the file in its Canvas. Linux (WebKitGTK in the app): the embed is isolated but its workers have no WebGL, so LibreOffice does not start: the pages as printed with Find and Replace, and the page's sentence sends to «Open in the browser». macOS and iOS (WKWebView, WebGL in workers since Safari 17) to confirm on a device; a phone sees the pages as in the page.

slides.note: The page's viewer and editor through embed=canvas inside the native frame. Documents and slides open the embed isolated as a whole (/embed-isolated.html, COOP/COEP): LibreOffice's frame has SharedArrayBuffer in WKWebView and WebKitGTK too (G42.8: Playwright WebKit and the Linux app), Chromium web views also through Document-Isolation-Policy. The engine comes down the first time with the page's bar (amounts, speed, time left, «Annulla», «Riprova») into the web view's storage (rg-zeta-*); Export as, PDF to print, the original's kept versions and Find/Replace through the page, their «Save as…» over the bridge. On a phone the pages as printed with Find and Replace (as the page). Where the engine still cannot start the page says why in the app's words and «Open in the browser» opens Rasgeth's page with the file in its Canvas. Linux (WebKitGTK in the app): the embed is isolated but its workers have no WebGL, so LibreOffice does not start: the pages as printed with Find and Replace, and the page's sentence sends to «Open in the browser». macOS and iOS (WKWebView, WebGL in workers since Safari 17) to confirm on a device; a phone sees the pages as in the page.

model.note: The page's ModelView and ModelEditor (three.js, WebGL works in every web view) through embed=canvas inside the native frame; Export as GLB/OBJ/STL/PLY/USDZ/PNG through the app's «Save as…», save state in the native bar.

archive.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside): a file inside opens in another tab of the app's Canvas (open).

font.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside).

tree.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside), with the syntax check; plain source as the fallback; editing in the page's editor inside the same embed (G42.7): collaboration, the agent's marks, «Changes», proposals and «changed outside» come with the page, the save state in the native bar (a failure with why and «Try saving again»), Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed on when the focus is in the frame, «Ask the agent» about a selection into the conversation's composer (a phone goes back to the conversation), an archived project's file opened in its viewer and said read only; TextEditor (CodeMirror): the selection with its lines, and the line being typed kept above a phone's keyboard.

site.note: Files and folders as sites, artifacts (App and Source, Run, Make it a project as the bar's actions), agents' ports: the page through embed=canvas/port in the native frame (G42.6); a link an agent-made page wants to open is asked natively (previewLink, G42.2); widgets in their frame (3.8.7); the native artifact frame and the sandboxed HTML stay as the fallback.

layers.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside) (OraView); editing in the page's editor inside the same embed (G42.7): collaboration, the agent's marks, «Changes», proposals and «changed outside» come with the page, the save state in the native bar (a failure with why and «Try saving again»), Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed on when the focus is in the frame, «Ask the agent» about a selection into the conversation's composer (a phone goes back to the conversation), an archived project's file opened in its viewer and said read only; ImageEditor: pen and touch, «Paste a picture» and Ctrl/Cmd+V as a new layer, PNG/JPEG/WebP/ORA/PSD export through «Save as…», «Open in Krita» not from a phone.

timeline.note: A video timeline (.rgvideo, G41.5b-G41.7, 3.10): the page's VideoEditor through embed=canvas inside the native frame like the other editors; the video's own integration (the phone layout of G41.5c checked in the web views, J/K/L, I/O and Ctrl+B passed on, a file dragged from the native tree, render progress in native notifications, «Ask the agent here» into the native composer, «Save as…» of the finished video and of the XML for Resolve, the viewer kind's word) comes with G42.18.

unknown.note: The page's viewer through embed=canvas inside the native frame (G42.6: tabs, bar from title and bar, reload, download, full screen, open outside): the page's byte sniffing (viewerFor) picks the viewer; the app tries any other file as text in the fallback.

file.note: Opens the file in the app's Canvas; «Download» as the page's «Save» (3.8.11): the same /api/files/raw, the system's «Save as» (a window on a computer, the system's picker on a phone), a bar with speed and time left past 1 MB. A message's attachment saved in the workspace downloads too.

variants.note: The card opens the native board (screens, choose, full screen, comments, history); each variant is the page in embed=board&variant=n&screen=…; #tavola= links in the chat open it too.

canvas.note: A line on a computer, a big card on a phone; a tap shows it again in the conversation's Canvas (the panel on the right, or the Canvas screen).

widget.note: In a web view on all five systems (WebKitGTK on Linux since G42.0); «Open in the page» only without a safe way to the server.

editor.attach.note: Used by the ACP bridge inside editors (packages/acp), not by the page.

editor.detach.note: Used by the ACP bridge inside editors (packages/acp), not by the page.

editor.fs.reply.note: Used by the ACP bridge inside editors (packages/acp), not by the page.

artifact.errors.note: Neither the page nor the app sends it: both use POST /api/artifacts/errors.

canvas.state.note: The page inside embed answers canvas.query as a tab of the page: the app tells every page its tabs and which one is in view (tabs), the page adds its own place and kind.

doc.close.note: Sent by the page's editors; in the app the page inside embed=canvas sends it over its own connection.

doc.decide.note: Sent by the page's editors; in the app the page inside embed=canvas sends it over its own connection.

canvas.open.note: What an agent shows opens by itself while the person watches (never from the replayed log): a panel on the right of the conversation on a computer, with tabs; the Canvas screen with the same tabs on a phone (G42.6). The same rule as the page's canvasEvent/openCanvas.

platform.changed.note: The page also refreshes projects on it (archived or restored).

turns.queue.note: The queue of agents waiting for a place: wall tiles, status bar, conversation banner, the queue window with «Move ahead».

places.$comment: Places of the page outside the five lists above (G42.5): its top bar's buttons and side areas.

explorer.note: The top bar's folder (Explorer.tsx): the conversation's place (project, personal agents' desk or platform, as currentScope), new file and folder, upload with keep both / replace, .rgartifact import, hidden files, refresh, terminal, rename, download, delete to .trash, copy path, ask the agent, open in the Canvas, search; archived projects read only. Computer: a resizable panel beside the conversation (or full window), kept open; files dropped from the system go into the folder under the pointer, a file dragged onto the conversation is attached. Phone: a screen of its own. A subproject's agent opens it on the subproject's folder (G24.13, the page's focus), and each subproject has its files button. «Terminal» (G42.5): any place but an archived project; on a computer a tab in the conversation's right column, on a phone the whole screen.

terminal.note: The page's TerminalView.tsx over /term, drawn natively by xterm 4.0.0 (MIT, pinned): full-screen programs, colours (the page's theme over xterm.js's palette), cursor and mouse modes, the size measured in hello and on resize, the page's red error and grey «closed» lines, «Open again». Computer: tabs in the conversation's right column beside the files and the Canvas (closed by their ×), Ctrl+Shift+C copies and Ctrl+V pastes, every other key to the program; also the advanced views. Phone: the whole screen with the keys row (Esc, Tab, Ctrl and Alt held for the next key, arrows, Home/End, PgUp/PgDn, | ~ / -, paste, keyboard) and text size.

canvas.note: The Canvas's frame (SideArea.tsx and Canvas.tsx's head): tabs with «Chat» and «Maximize», the bar (name, kind and weight from title, save state, the agent's move, the tab's own buttons from bar, keyboard map, reload, download, full screen, open outside), the divider; on a phone the Canvas screen with the same tabs. A few web views alive together (three, two on a phone, one on Linux), the others loaded again on return. Ctrl/Cmd+S, Z, Shift+Z, F passed to the page.

subagentSign.note: A sub-agent's sign instead of a mascot (decision of 2026-11-19, board choice A): the ring in its parent's colour, the same drawing as the page's subagentSignSvg (Mascot.tsx), checked pixel by pixel against the library (test/subagent_sign_test.dart). Every MascotView of a sub-agent shows it: tabs, team, Room, approvals, the computer's rail and lists.
